attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created system user inventorysvc and system group inventory-readers, then chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers and set dirs to 750 / files to 640 across the tree, preserving existing file contents. Verified via inspection, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured a healthy pre-restart baseline (boot_id, ownership/perms, file contents), issued a native reboot, polled until exec was available again, confirmed the boot_id changed (proving an actual restart, not just elapsed time), and re-verified ownership, permissions, group readability, and unchanged file contents post-restart.
